highlights.title: Creator of free Adobe clones unveils open-source Microsoft Office Excel, PowerPoint, and Word replications
highlights.description: ArtCraft is expanding its roster of open-source creative tools as cross-platform alternatives to predatory subscription models.

highlights.title: Vurt wants you to look at vertical videos as a genre of their own
highlights.description: From Disney Plus to HBO Max, almost every major established streaming service is experimenting with ways to get into vertical content. It's clear that these companies see video-focused social media platforms like TikTok and Instagram as existential threats. highlights.title: What to expect from Apple’s ‘Welcome Home’ event
highlights.description: We are quickly coming up on Apple's "Welcome Home" launch event, where we expect a host of smart home-related announcements. We are expecting refreshes to Apple TV and HomePod Mini, as well as a brand new smart home hub. We could also see the debut of a new platform called homeOS, and some partner devices from LG. highlights.title: Apple Supplier Luxshare Expects No Material Impact From US Probe
highlights.description: Apple Inc. supplier Luxshare Precision Industry Co. is facing a US patent investigation into data-center power technologies following infringement allegations by Vicor Corp., according to a filing on Saturday.

highlights.title: Programmer ports Super Mario 64 to Microsoft’s Zune HD media player
highlights.description: A fan port of Nintendo’s Super Mario 64 runs natively on Microsoft’s 2009 Zune HD media player, with touch controls and saves.

highlights.title: I Made Terrible Games With Google’s AI Playground
highlights.description: A long day’s haul in the video game slop mines.

highlights.title: Rumor: Apple to Announce New Partnership With ADT
highlights.description: Apple may be planning to announce a new partnership with home security company ADT, alongside the introduction of its all-new smart home hub, according to several clues. Apple has invited the media to a "Welcome home" experience in New York on Tuesday, October 13, so the partnership could be made official on that day. highlights.title: 459 hp, 0-60 in 3.9 sec, and AWD – meet Mitsubishi’s new-age electric EVO [video]
highlights.description: Mitusbishi’s North American dealers have been trudging along with an aging, badge-engineered model line for years – but overseas? It’s a different story, and the 459 hp all-wheel drive ASX VR-e electric hot hatch shown here is plug-in proof. more…

highlights.title: Cryptomining malware used poetry to infect more than 3,400 servers, researchers say
highlights.description: Lumen's Black Lotus Labs says PoeLLM malware has hit more than 3,400 servers, most of them exposed AI tools like LiteLLM and Ollama.
